motion.name: fallback-reveal
motion.purpose: Hide SVG only after WebGL is ready; reduced motion removes the transition.

motion.name: trail-duration
motion.purpose: Arrival animation or deliberate replay, followed by slower continuous ambient trails and sparks. Pause control stops motion; pause offscreen and in hidden documents; dynamically import on visible island hydration.

motion.name: trail-travel
motion.purpose: Bounded request travel along the speed curve; illustrative, not measured performance.

motion.name: trail-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stop motion immediately when preference changes; speed replay is disabled with Reduced motion label. Flow can reseed statically.

motion.name: trail-lifecycle
motion.purpose: Cap device pixel ratio at 1.5; retain deterministic SVG on no-JS, no-WebGL, or context loss; remove frames, observers, listeners, GPU resources, and canvas on navigation. Docs do not import Three.js.

motion.name: theme-artwork
motion.purpose: Keep yellow artwork legible against the active global theme.

narrative.overview:
DihLabs presents a developer's work with an immersive introduction, open space, and direct editorial lists. OPTZ shares the same monochrome world, adding a playful request character and a sense of speed. The approved composition is confident and clear; Next.js informs hierarchy without supplying the identity. Documentation draws on the user-pinned Next.js, Angular, Linear, shadcn and Raycast references for a familiar reading interface.

Generative yellow geometry is the expressive element. Interface controls, navigation, status, and technical evidence remain monochrome. DihLabs leads with development work and writing; AI, SDXL, and language-model showcases are outside its approved identity.
keyCharacteristics: Large, closely tracked sans-serif headings and generous reading space.
Device-aware light and dark themes across introductions, editorial content, and documentation, with restrained rules.
Yellow Three.js artwork with an arrival animation, continuous ambient motion, and deliberate replay.

rules.name: Artwork Only
rules.body: Reserve yellow for the generated trails and request character. Controls, focus, status, and benchmark bars stay monochrome.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Use surface tone and thin rules to separate content. Reserve interface shadows for floating search results and the product menu.

dos: Do use the shared shadcn Button variants and the active surface tokens.
Do preserve the visible keyboard focus, wrapped mobile navigation, and readable text measures.
Do provide a pause control, respect reduced motion, and retain the deterministic SVG fallback.
Do present benchmark scope and methodology beside measured results.
donts: Don't copy Next.js branding or page composition.
Don't use yellow for interface controls, status indicators, or focus rings.
Don't replace developer content with an AI or SDXL showcase.
Don't turn illustrative speed into a universal performance claim or remove the motion pause control.

decisions.name: Documentation evidence and code
decisions.description: Use accessible CSS-icon support states, zero-based benchmark charts sourced from checked-in JSON with provenance and exact-value disclosures, and build-time Shiki VS Code Light+/Dark+ syntax colors. Syntax token colors are confined to code; charts remain monochrome.
